top_signals.title: ICICI Joins Indian Banks Chasing Dollar Loans, Swelling Demand
top_signals.summary: India’s ICICI Bank Ltd. has launched a syndicated offshore loan of about $1.45 billion, according to people familiar with the matter, joining a growing number of local banks tapping overseas debt to capitalize on a central bank facility that lowers hedging costs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Brussels flower carpet pays homage to Hokusai’s ‘Great Wave’
top_signals.summary: Some 750,000 dahlias are arranged in the design of the iconic work at an event to mark 160 years of diplomatic relations between Japan and Belgium.
